程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

接口 MenuType

所有超级接口:
FeatureDependant, net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, Keyed
所有已知子接口:
MenuType.Typed<V,B>
@NullMarked @Experimental public interface MenuType extends Keyed, FeatureDependant
代表不同类型的视图 (也称为菜单), 可由玩家创建和查看.

原文： Represents different kinds of views, also known as menus, which can be created and viewed by the player.

  • 方法详细资料

    • create

      InventoryView create(HumanEntity player, @Nullable net.kyori.adventure.text.Component title)
      Creates a view of the specified menu type.

      The player provided to create this view must be the player the view is opened for. See HumanEntity.openInventory(InventoryView) for more information.

      参数:
      player - the player the view belongs to
      title - the title of the view
      返回:
      the created InventoryView

    • typed

      MenuType.Typed<InventoryView,InventoryViewBuilder<InventoryView>> typed()
      将此 MenuType 作为使用普通 InventoryView 表示的类型化版本返回.

      原文： Yields this MenuType as a typed version of itself with a plain InventoryView representing it.

      返回:
      类型化的 MenuType

      原文：the typed MenuType.

    • typed

      <V extends InventoryView, B extends InventoryViewBuilder<V>> MenuType.Typed<V,B> typed(java.lang.Class<V> viewClass) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      将此 MenuType 作为使用特定 InventoryView 表示的类型化版本返回.

      原文： Yields this MenuType as a typed version of itself with a specific InventoryView representing it.

      类型参数:
      V - 获取此 MenuType 时使用的 InventoryView 的泛型类型

      原文：the generic type of the InventoryView to get this MenuType with

      B - 获取此 MenuType 时使用的 InventoryViewBuilder 的泛型类型

      原文：the generic type of the InventoryViewBuilder to get this MenuType with

      参数:
      viewClass - 用于类型化此 InventoryView 的 InventoryView 类类型

      原文：the class type of the InventoryView to type this InventoryView with.

      返回:
      类型化的 MenuType

      原文：the typed MenuType

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的 viewClass 无法被类型化为此 MenuType

      原文：if the provided viewClass cannot be typed to this MenuType

    • getInventoryViewClass

      java.lang.Class<? extends InventoryView> getInventoryViewClass()
      获取此 MenuType 的 InventoryView 类.

      原文： Gets the InventoryView class of this MenuType.

      返回:
      此 MenuType 的 InventoryView 类

      原文：the InventoryView class of this MenuType
